Orrin lint filter recall

Stop using lint filters from batch 7921 with the Orrin heat pump, and return them for a refund.

Check the batch marking on your filter packaging to find out whether your filter is affected. If the marking matches, switch off the appliance and remove the filter when safe. Do not use the heat pump without a suitable lint filter fitted.

Please keep the packaging to help us identify the affected batch. Contact Halvard Home customer support for help arranging your return and refund, or if the marking is missing, damaged or unclear.

We apologise for the inconvenience and appreciate your help in keeping your appliance safe.

Side brushes for the Vale fridge freezer

Stop using side brushes from batch 2897 with the Vale fridge freezer, and return them for a refund.

Halvard Home is asking customers to check the batch details printed on the side brush packaging before using these accessories with their appliance.

If your brushes are affected, please set them aside and contact Halvard Home customer support for guidance on returning them and receiving your refund.

If the packaging is unavailable, or the batch details are difficult to read, please contact customer support for advice rather than continuing to use the brushes.

We apologise for the inconvenience and appreciate your help in handling this return safely.

Mira lint filter notice

Stop using lint filters from batch 6263 with the Mira robot vacuum, and return them for a refund.

Please check the batch marking on your filter packaging before using your vacuum. If it matches, switch off the vacuum, remove the filter and keep it separate from household waste. Do not fit the affected filter again.

Contact Halvard Home customer support for guidance on returning the filter and receiving your refund. Please keep the packaging if available, as it may help us identify the affected product. If the packaging is missing or the marking is unclear, stop using the filter and ask our support team for advice. We are sorry for the inconvenience and appreciate your help.

Orrin heat pump travel case notice

Stop using travel cases from batch 6453 with the Orrin heat pump, and return them for a refund.

Check the batch label on your travel case to see whether it is affected. If the label is missing, damaged or unclear, please contact Halvard Home customer support for advice before using the case again.

Keep the affected case separate from your heat pump while arranging its return. Our customer support team can explain the returns process and help you request your refund. Please have the case label available when contacting us, if possible.

We apologise for the inconvenience and appreciate your cooperation. Thank you for helping us keep Halvard Home products safe to use.

Important descaling tablet notice

Stop using descaling tablets from batch 2873 with the Corra induction hob, and return them for a refund.

Halvard Home is recalling the affected tablets because they may not be suitable for this appliance. Please check the batch details printed on the packaging. Keep affected tablets away from your hob and leave them in their original packaging, if available.

Take the tablets back to the shop where you bought them and ask for a refund. If the packaging is missing, or you need help with your return, please contact Halvard Home customer support for guidance.

We apologise for the inconvenience and appreciate your cooperation in helping us resolve this issue.

Cleaning gel pouch safety notice

Stop using cleaning gel pouches from batch 9421 with the Fenwick cooker hood, and return them for a refund.

Halvard Home asks customers to check the batch details printed on the pouch packaging before cleaning their cooker hood. If your pouches belong to the affected batch, leave them sealed and keep them away from children and pets. Please return them to the shop where you bought them, or contact Halvard Home customer support for help arranging a return and refund. Do not pour the gel down the sink or put it in household waste.

We apologise for the inconvenience and appreciate your help with this precaution.

Outdoor fan grille notice

Stop using outdoor fan grilles from batch 7264 with the Ashby tumble dryer, and return them for a refund.

Halvard Home is asking customers to check outdoor fan grilles supplied for use with the Ashby tumble dryer. Please look for the batch label on your grille or its packaging to confirm whether it is affected. If the label is missing, damaged or difficult to read, contact Halvard Home customer support for advice. Do not fit or reuse an affected grille. Customer support can explain how to return the grille and arrange your refund. Please keep the packaging if you still have it. We apologise for the inconvenience and appreciate your cooperation.
